sheets.title: Joiner's first ask refused: the owner's key changed — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Two Chromium contexts. A new device that remembers another peer opens the owner's invite link, gives the code, a name, a PIN for its own vault and the owner's peer trust signal, and asks. The ask creates the joiner's vault, the form mounts again, and the remembered-key check refuses. Read from the joiner's page once the tray holds the notice.

sheets.after: Row mark "This peer's key changed" present (20×20 @280,511); Ask to join disabled (40×40 @280,545), named "Ask to join. This peer's key changed"
